prompt: Give me a one-liner to find all files modified in the last 24 hours under /var/www, sorted by size descending, showing size in human-readable format and absolute path. Then give me a 3-line variant that excludes .log files and excludes the /var/www/cache subdir.

result.content:
**One-liner:**

```bash
find /var/www -type f -mtime -1 -exec du -h {} + | sort -hr
```

**3-line variant (excludes `.log` files and `/var/www/cache`):**

```bash
find /var/www -type f -mtime -1 \
  ! -name "*.log" \
  ! -path "/var/www/cache/*" \
  -exec du -h {} + | sort -hr
```

**Breakdown:**

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `find /var/www -type f` | Only regular files under `/var/www` |
| `-mtime -1` | Modified within the last 24 hours |
| `! -name "*.log"` | Exclude `.log` files |
| `! -path "/var/www/cache/*"` | Exclude everything under the cache subdirectory |
| `-exec du -h {} +` | Print human-readable size + absolute path |
| `sort -hr` | Sort numerically by human-readable size, descending |
